title: llm-autoscaling-cost-optimizer-scratchpad-ryan-cho
content:
Purpose: sketch product + infra ideas for an autoscaling + cost optimizer feature that suggests and optionally applies runtime config changes (batching, prefetch, routing, quantization profile) to hit cost targets while meeting latency SLOs.

Context / motivation:
- Customers (PLG apps, platform teams) repeatedly ask: how do I reduce token cost without breaking p95 latency?
- We have knobs at multiple layers: batching window, max batch size, prefix/KV caching, model variant routing (quantized vs full), instance sizing for Dedicated pools, and region routing.
- Ops set overly conservative configs to avoid regressions => wasted $$ and capacity.
- Idea: a product that observes traffic, proposes per-route config changes, simulates expected impact, and can either auto-apply or suggest to operator.

High level feature pillars:
1) Measurement plane: continuously measure per-route latency distribution, cost per token, token mix (seq len dist), cache hit rates, and KV cache effectiveness.
2) Simulation engine: given current traffic profile, estimate impact of changing batching params / kv-prefetch / model variant mix on cost and latency. Also model autoscale response for Dedicated.
3) Suggestion UI: in Console, show per-route recommendations with expected savings, risk (delta p95), and easy rollback.
4) Auto-run opt mode: opt-in automated adjustments with guardrails + canary rollout.
5) Audit + explainability: logs of changes, before/after metrics, can link to eval prompt sets to verify quality.

Rough user stories:
- As a growth engineer, I want the console to show where we are wasting tokens and get 1-click recommendations to reduce cost by X% while keeping p95 under target.
- As an infra owner, I want safe automatic batching increases during stable low-latency traffic and auto-revert if p95 increases > 10%.
- As an SRE for a regulated customer, I want recommendations but only as non-automatic proposals (no auto-apply).
- As a product engineer, I want to run a canary that routes 10% of traffic to the optimized config and compare metrics before rolling out to 100%.

Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- Collect per-route metrics for N routes over a 7-day window: p50/p95/p99, tokens per request, cache hit rate, model variant usage.
- Provide at least three recommendation types: increase batching window, enable prefix KV prefetch for matching prompts, and route short queries to quantized variant.
- In Console, display recommendation with estimated cost delta (USD/month) and estimated p95 delta.
- Provide a toggle to apply recommendation for a single route and record audit log entry.
- Implement safety rollback: if p95 increases > configured threshold within 10 minutes after apply, auto-revert and notify.

Metrics to track success:
- Average cost savings per route (USD/month) after enabling suggestions.
- Fraction of recommendations accepted.
- Rate of rollbacks / regressions triggered.
- Customer satisfaction (NPS/CSAT) for paid Dedicated customers using the feature.

Technical considerations / implementation sketches:
- Data pipeline: extend Console traces to store token-level metrics with sequence length histograms and KV cache hit counters. Use existing observability infra (traces -> metrics -> TSDB).
- Simulation: offline micro-batcher that replays representative traffic and estimates latency changes using model perf profiles (we have per-model P50/P95 curves for batch sizes + seq len). Use interpolation to estimate delta latency when increasing batch size.
- Cost model: combine tokens * model unit cost + GPU runtime amortized by batch efficiency improvements. Also factor in savings from routing to quantized model variants.
- Autoscaling interaction: for Dedicated, model how instance count would change with throughput changes and whether increased batching reduces CPU/GPU utilization.
- Safety: assign confidence score to each recommendation; only auto-apply if confidence >= threshold and customer has opt-in.

UX / Console notes:
- Recommendations listed per-route with small sparkline for p95 and cost trend, estimated savings badge (e.g., -23% cost), risk tag (low/medium/high).
- Preview mode: shows expected before/after graphs by simulating 24h of traffic.
- Can run canary with percent traffic slider, duration and rollback triggers.
- Audit timeline: who applied what, with diff of config.

Open questions / unknowns:
- How accurate are our latency interpolation models across model arch + quantization? Need calibration run.
- What is the right minimum traffic threshold to make reliable recommendations (e.g., >1000 requests/day)?
- Should recommendations be per-route or per-customer default? Many customers have multi-route heterogeneity.
- Pricing implications: if we auto-change model routing to q4_0, do we require explicit consent? Some customers may have quality constraints.
- Interplay with caching: enabling KV prefetch may increase upstream cost (prefetch compute) but reduce repeated compute; need to simulate net impact.

Experiment ideas / quick wins:
- Run a small experiment on internal demo account: increase batching window from 5ms to 20ms for non-chat short requests and measure p95 & cost.
- Detect short prompts (<64 tokens) and route to quantized variant by default for eligible models; A/B test quality via eval set.
- Heuristic recommendations first (conservative) then upgrade to simulation-based suggestions later.

Rollout plan (phases):
1) Internal MVP: measurement + 2 heuristic recs (batching, short-query routing) + manual apply in Console. Test on Redwood demo org and 3 pilot customers.
2) Simulation engine + cost estimator + canary UI. 3 pilot customers, opt-in.
3) Auto-opt mode (opt-in) for Dedicated customers with stricter safety rails.
4) Expand to Hosted customers with per-tenant guardrails and opt-in.

Next steps / TODOs:
- Sync with applied-ml to validate latency interpolation approach (Aisha).
- Build data slice for three demo routes to calibrate models (Jordan).
- Draft console mockups for recommendation card and canary flow (Priya).
- Create JIRA epic and link repos for simulation code.

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Could tie into Optimize product: surface suggestions in Optimize recommendations feed and allow cli/apply via API.
- Think about cost transparency: show tokens saved and equivalent dollars immediately to drive adoption.
- Long-term: allow policy rules (e.g., "never route to quantized model for route X") and per-route thresholds.

References / related docs:
- previous scratchpads: llm-routing-prefetch-cost-ideas-olivia-hsu (good notes on prefetch cost tradeoffs)
- infra perf profiles: model-performance-profiles-v2 (Confluence)
- jira: JIRA-INF-3421 (autoscale-simulation-epic)

Random brainstorm bullets (untidy):
- auto-detect "stable windows" (off-peak) and apply aggressive batching only during those windows
- ML model to predict p95 given batch size + seq len dist instead of interpolation
- allow customers to set a cost-goal (USD/month) and have the optimizer try to meet it with minimal quality impact

End of scratchpad.
